headline: Jalandhar Records Zero Fire Detections on November 27, 2025
briefing: On 2025-11-27, Jalandhar recorded 0 fire detections, ranking 9 among Punjab's districts, which had a total of 13 detections. The nearest monitored city, Ludhiana, experienced winds blowing from the NNW at a speed of 2.4 km/h with an upwind fire pressure score of 14.6. Outside Punjab contributed 78.5% of this upwind pressure, while Kapurthala and Hoshiarpur contributed 10.3% and 9.2%, respectively. Ludhiana's next-day PM2.5 forecast anticipates a p50 of 100.7 ug/m3, with an uncertainty band ranging from a p10 of 73.8 ug/m3 to a p90 of 127.0 ug/m3, compared to today's level of 107.4 ug/m3. Satellite fire detections represent a lower bound due to missed fires, cloud cover, and overpass timing [K099]. Forecast reliability on held-out test seasons shows an 80% interval coverage of 87.7% with a mean absolute error of 11.0.
